description: On the green tabletop there’s a small white square-table/bench model piece with four upright posts near the wall. The left hand reaches in and grips one of the inner block components, wiggling it upward while the right hand stays on the base to steady it as a two-hand object, then the left hand pulls the loosened block out and sets it down to the left, leaving the base held by the right hand as a right-hand object.
